r: An Accountant is responsible for managing and maintaining the organization’s financial records, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely financial reporting. The role supports business decision-making by preparing financial reports, monitoring financial transactions, analyzing costs and variances, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and company policies.

Support the global AP team in ensuring the accuracy of supplier invoices and goods receipts. Coordinate with local buyers to resolve purchase order discrepancies against invoices before submission to the processing team for final payment.

Liaise with Sales and Operations to minimize the impact of excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory.
Review and validate Proof of Delivery (POD) documentation to support accurate revenue recognition.
Prepare and report CAPEX documentation, ensuring expenditures are accurately tracked in Oracle and SAP in a timely manner.
Support ad hoc financial reporting and other finance-related activities as required.

This positioning is aligned with the leadership competencies used in Rotana's senior operational roles.

Strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian hospitality market and previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be highly preferred.
Excellent leadership, strategic planning, financial and stakeholder-management capabilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with fluency in English; Arabic would be an advantage.
A hands-on, commercially astute and results-driven leadership style, with the ability to inspire diverse teams and successfully manage multiple properties.
